primary_endpoint: Mean change from baseline in PASI score up to Week 12.
efficacy_outcome: Reported values were 15.7 and 15.9 for secukinumab and placebo, respectively, and 0.8 and 13.4 for secukinumab and placebo, respectively; the registry summary does not clarify these values or report statistical comparisons.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events: 1/7 with secukinumab and 0/3 with placebo; no deaths in either arm.
